description: 构建健康测评系统核心后端架构。5步问卷（年龄→性别→身体数据→目标→运动频率）→ 服务端健康算法（BMI/BMR/TDEE/目标预测）→ 订阅差异化结果（FREE脱敏 vs PREMIUM完整）→ 模拟支付闭环。参考 BetterMe Quiz Funnel，重点展示 API 设计、数据库建模、鉴权闭环。

userStories.title: POST /api/quiz/step — 分步数据保存

userStories.title: POST /api/quiz/complete — 完成测评并计算
userStories.description: As a user, I want the server to execute health assessment algorithms (BMI/BMR/TDEE/target date/weekly projection) after completing all steps.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/quiz/complete checks all 5 steps are completed
Missing steps returns 400 { code:INCOMPLETE_QUIZ, details:{ missingSteps } }
Already completed returns 409 { code:ALREADY_COMPLETED }
Calculates BMI: weight(kg)/height(m)² with 4-tier classification
Calculates BMR: Mifflin-St Jeor formula (gender-specific)
Calculates TDEE: BMR × activity coefficient (5 levels)
Calculates recommended calories: TDEE ± 500/300kcal based on goal
Calculates target date: |targetWeight - currentWeight| / 0.75kg × 7 days
Generates weekly projection: linear interpolation from today to target date
Writes HealthResult record linked to userId
Typecheck passes
